notes.title: Hotfix Update. Patched Game-Breaking Bug 11/3/2024
notes.notes: It has come to my attention that a game-breaking bug has appeared when participating in the 'Opening Act' for Limerence Theater. This has been patched. All files have now been included into the game build. If you have any other issues in regards to this patch, contact us via (kizunedev@gmail.com). This is also a test to see if the current patch updated all your save files correctly. We are sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: My Fantasy Hostess Club is Live!
notes.notes:
My Fantasy Hostess Club is finally released on Steam!

Today marks the first day of MFHC being live on the Steam platform. Thank you for anticipating the release of GenKizune's first title.

Feel free to leave a review on the Store Page or contact us for any technical difficulties, comments, or concerns to the e-mail (kizunedev@gmail.com). Please be aware that any bugs, if found, may be fixed in the coming weeks in a full patch so responses to individual issues may not be immediate. 

But for now, enjoy hosting!

notes.title: My Fantasy Hostess Club is Releasing this October 11th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108508/8d5f4217c24d4144d3710ec7cc96b8bfdfe83ade.png[/img]
Hello!
GenKizune here, developer of My Fantasy Hostess Club (MFHC). 

First and foremost, I would like to thank the people who played MFHC's demo and wishlisted my game on Steam. I really appreciate all the feedback and interest generated for this project born out of passion. From the bottom of my heart, thank you.

I am excited to announce that [u][b]My Fantasy Hostess Club will finally be getting a 1.0 release on October 11, 2024![/b][/u] It's been a long time coming and it should have been published months ago but some technical difficulties and reworking has pushed back the date, but we're finally here and hopefully it will provide a good piece of entertainment for both you and the customers of Opulence Haven.

This started out as a small project and has scoped to better heights than what I could have imagined since creating the first scene for MFHC but I'm happy that I was able to finally complete and soon release my first-ever Steam game. So, I hope you enjoy your time playing through this small cozy adventure and management sim in a fantasy world once it releases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108508/16167f9de57e727a1d2d370b8896f630f237afbb.png[/img]

I will be posting more updates on my official Twitter page (@GenKizune) and YouTube channel. Until then, please stay tuned!
